== Biography ==
Jessy was born about 1820. She was a daughter of [[Glasgow-971|Alexander Glasgow]] and [[Smith-228705|Ellen Smith]]. The University of Galway's Landed Estates Database identifies Alexander and Ellen's children as John, William and Jessy, and states that Jessy married Edward Eyre Newenham of Maryborough in 1853.<ref>University of Galway, [https://landedestates.ie/estate/3101 "Glasgow"], ''Landed Estates Database'', estate 3101 (accessed 19 August 2026).</ref>
